På psykakuten i Malmö möter personalen mänsklig utsatthet och en ny verklighet där AI riskerar att förvärra psykisk ohälsa. – Vi kan göra allt rätt och ändå blir det fel, säger psykiatrisjuksköterskan Mattias.

en.title: An evening at the psych emergency ward: “Our job is sometimes to say what you don't want to hear”
en.summary: What is it like to work somewhere where decisions can sometimes be a matter of life and death? At the psychiatric emergency ward in Malmö, staff encounter human vulnerability and a new reality where AI risks worsening mental ill-health. – We can do everything right and still get it wrong, says psychiatric nurse Mattias.

sv.title: Så svarar Open AI på Ekots granskning
sv.summary: Ekot har granskat säkerheten i en AI-chatt, och visat hur chattverktyget kan underlätta planeringen av – i det här fallet – en skolattack. Daniel Öhman, en av Ekots reportrar som gjort granskningen, berättar vilka frågor de ställt till Open AI och vad de svarat.

en.title: How Open AI responds to Ekot's investigation
en.summary: Ekot has examined the security of an AI chat and shown how the chat tool can facilitate the planning of – in this case – a school attack. Daniel Öhman, one of the Ekot reporters who carried out the investigation, explains what questions they asked Open AI and what they answered.

en.title: Survey: AI used to plan attacks around the world
en.summary: AI chats are said to have been used in planning at least ten suspected school attacks and other attacks around the world, Ekot's survey shows. In two of the cases, in Canada and the USA, legal proceedings are under way against Open AI, the owner of the AI tool ChatGPT.
